tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 kun bzang rigs lnga rig 'dzin rdo rje chos// las kyi dbang chen rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gter ston chos dbang la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par shog /mi bskyod rdo rje dwags ston gnyan ston dang*// se lding yab sras chos sku 'od zer zhabs// dpal 'byor dbang phyug chos kyi dbang po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par shog /rig 'dzin legs ldan zhabs dang mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// dbang phyug rab brtan bsod nams mchog ldan dpal// 'phrin las lhun grub gter brgyud dang po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par shog /pad gling rgyal ba don grub rang grol mtshan// bstan 'dzin grags pa mdo sngags bstan 'dzin bzang*// phrin las lhun grub gter brgyud gnyis pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par shog /

kha skong*/ brgyud srol kun 'dus gter chen chos kyi rgyal// rin chen rnam rgyal klong yangs 'od gsal zhabs// mchog sprul pad dbang khri chen pad rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par shog /'phrin las chos sgron sangs rgyas kun dga'i mtshan// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i srog 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs// 'phrin las yongs grub rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms par shog / brgyud 'debs kha skong gu ṇas so// gzhi dus ting 'dzin gsum gyi rol pa las// dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rnam par yongs shar bas// sgo gsum las nyon mun pa dbyings sbyangs nas// 'bras bu sku gsum go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa 'gyur med rdo rjes so//
